name: moodle-mcp
description: Connect MCP clients to Moodle through secure browser login.
long_description:
Moodle MCP connects MCP clients to Moodle LMS and Moodle Workplace. Ask about upcoming deadlines, check grades, browse course resources, and read assignment feedback.

Local installations authenticate through the browser and store the resulting Moodle token in the operating system credential store. Token and username/password environment variables remain available for advanced use.
